purpose: Winner-independent diagnosis of the dominant upstream strategy-memory instability observed after the policy-refit decomposition.

trigger_evidence.adjudication: UPSTREAM_STRATEGY_MEMORY_GENERATION_IS_PRIMARY_OBSERVED_SOURCE; final AveragePolicy learner randomness remains nonzero but is secondary.

sampling_factor_controls: collector stochastic opponent-action draws after the two exact opponent levels
factorial.decoupling_note: Production Phase2 couples collector sampling and optimizer minibatch draws through one batch_rng. This diagnostic intentionally separates those namespaces so the two causal families can be contrasted. The diagnostic is not itself a production-training change.
factorial.collector_rng_initialization: random.Random(sampling_seed XOR 0xC0FFEE), persisted exactly across staged iterations without optimizer draws advancing it
factorial.deck_seed_function: unchanged production deck_seed function with sampling_seed substituted for the original coupled training_seed
factorial.learning_runtime_identity: existing Phase2 checkpoint training_seed field carries learning_memory_seed so all existing advantage/reset/ensemble/reservoir semantics remain intact

fixed_final_policy_readout.reason: Do not reintroduce final AveragePolicy learner randomness while measuring upstream strategy-memory differences.
fixed_final_policy_readout.learner_seed_derivation: first four big-endian SHA256 bytes of 'SpinCore|R7.5.3C|UPSTREAM-FACTORIAL|FINAL-POLICY-LEARNER', masked to 31 bits

evaluation.metric: total variation distance between fixed-final-learner AveragePolicy distributions on identical frozen heldout SPNNIV3 states/legal slots

contrasts.same_sampling_different_learning_memory_: isolates learning/reservoir family while deck/traversal sampling is fixed
contrasts.different_sampling_same_learning_memory_: isolates deck/traversal sampling family while learning/reservoir randomness is fixed

evaluation.interpretation: The larger controlled contrast identifies the more important upstream instability family. No result from this diagnostic may select H2 or H3. If learning/reservoir dominates, split initialization/reset/ensemble from reservoir/minibatch randomness next. If deck/traversal dominates, test controlled/common deal-traversal schedules and/or increased root support before rerunning admission.
